decisive_items: bilateral breast nodules suggestive of fibroadenomas
pathogenic variant in the FH gene (FHc.999C > A p.Cys333Ter)
response.rationale: R4 uniquely integrates the FH gene pathogenic variant with the breast nodules, directly supporting HLRCC syndrome. R1 only addresses the pelvic mass histology without the genetic or syndromic context. R6 is limited to breast findings and ignores the pelvic mass and genetics.

rejected.why: Only cites breast nodules, missing the pelvic mass, histopathology, and FH gene mutation, so it is not a comprehensive diagnosis.
Cites ovarian primary and spindle cell histology but fails to account for the FH gene mutation and breast nodules, making it a partial diagnosis.
